_what: How the Gantt view (show/views/ScheduleView.tsx) draws time, one row per step of its zoom: `day_px` how wide a day is, `head` what the second heading row counts (each day, or each week by its first day), `before_days` and `after_days` how far the time axis reaches before the earliest bar or today and after the latest bar or today. `row_px` is how tall every row is, `max_days` the most days an axis may cover (an axis longer than that keeps today in view and drops the rest), `scroll_lead_px` how much room it leaves before today when it opens. Adding a zoom step is one row. `words` is every sentence the view says. Dragging a bar or its ends, or nudging it with arrow keys, writes the dates through the surface's record writer so Undo takes it back.

words.empty: Nothing to place on the schedule yet.
